test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **tackle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct filler to be used in option 3 is tackle.​​
 
• The word tackle means, 'to make an effort to deal with a difficult situation or problem (**कठिन स्थिति या समस्‍या का हल निकालने का प्रयास करना**)'
 
 
• **Ex:** *The government must **tackle** the problem of rising unemployment.*
 
 
 
• The sentence of the cloze test containing blank (3) describes the action being taken regularly in order to tackle or solve the issue of road safety.

 

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 2).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Government is taking seriously the (1) issue__ of road safety and is committed to reducing the number of people killed in accidents. Forums are being conducted (2) __regularly__ to bring law-makers, law enforcement officers and road users together to discuss ways to (3) __**tackle**__ the rise in road accidents. Everyone agrees that more needs to be done on road safety in its determination to (4) ______ the rate of road accidents in the country. The Government, with the cooperation of relevant agencies, is making serious (5) ______ to instil proper road culture in children, young adults and the public in general.
